title: Data Structure Forge exam
summary: The world's mastery exam: 5 complexity, 5 selection, 3 debugging, 3 implementation and 4 scenario questions. Each section needs 70% on its own.

questions.prompt: What is the average time of HashMap.get?
What is the time of PriorityQueue.poll on n elements?
What is the time of PriorityQueue.peek?
What is the time of ArrayDeque.addFirst and pollLast?
What is the worst-case time to search an unbalanced binary search tree of n keys?
A browser's back button returns to the most recently visited page.
A printer handles jobs in the order they were sent.
Patients are treated by urgency, most urgent first, as new patients keep arriving.
options: A sorted list, re-sorted on every arrival

questions.prompt: Find all products priced between 10 and 20, with prices changing often.
options: A TreeMap from price to products, using subMap
A HashMap from price to products

questions.prompt: Repeatedly merge friend groups and ask whether two people are in the same group.
options: BFS over the friendship graph for every question

questions.prompt: This stack's pop() sometimes crashes with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. What's wrong?
options: It doesn't check for an empty stack, so size becomes -1 and indexes the array at -1
push and pop use different arrays

questions.prompt: A Point is put in a HashSet, then its x field is changed. Now set.contains(point) returns false. Why?
options: Its hashCode changed, so the set looks in a different bucket than the one it was stored in
equals is never called by HashSet
Points can't be stored in sets

questions.prompt: This BFS takes forever on graphs with cycles. What's missing?
options: It never marks nodes as seen, so cycles queue the same nodes again and again
It should start from every node

questions.prompt: Complete the line that takes the next job from the front of a Queue<Job> called jobs (null if empty).
Order the steps for adding a value to a min-heap stored in an array.
steps: Stop when the parent is smaller or the value reaches the root
Put the value in the next free slot at the end
While it's smaller than its parent, swap it with the parent

questions.prompt: Complete the recursive count of nodes in a binary tree.
Suggest words as a user types each letter of a prefix.
options: A HashSet of all words, checking each one

questions.prompt: A cache that evicts the least recently used entry when full, with O(1) get and put.
options: A LinkedHashMap in access order (or a hash map plus a doubly linked list)
A TreeMap keyed by insertion time

questions.prompt: Report the median of a stream of numbers after each new one.
options: Two heaps: a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half

questions.prompt: Find an order to take courses so every prerequisite comes first.
options: Topological sort of the prerequisite graph
